KEYS_ERR_NO_KEY: You do not have the keys to this vehicle
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Who can lock a vehicle and how hard lockpicking is.
ADMIN_C_LOCK_DESC: Players lock and unlock vehicles they have keys to with L.
ADMIN_C_LOCKPICK_DESC: Using a lockpick next to a locked vehicle opens it; from the driver seat it starts the engine.
ADMIN_H_LOCK_DISTANCE: How close the player must be to the vehicle.
ADMIN_H_UNLOCK_CHANCE: Chance a lockpick opens a locked door.
ADMIN_H_HOTWIRE_CHANCE: Chance the engine starts; the player then has the keys until leaving the server.
ADMIN_H_BREAK_CHANCE: Chance the lockpick breaks when a try fails.
